description: `Undo -> .H`, written in `C`, targets `C`'s own history state without leaving `C`: with no record it enters `C`'s default entry, `A`; after `C` was left in `B` and entered again through `H`, and moved back to `A`, it returns to `B`, what `C` recorded when it was last left. `C` is neither exited nor recorded by it.
